StringWithMarkup.String: Quinaldic acid is a quinolinemonocarboxylic acid having the carboxy group at the 2-position. It has a role as a Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite and a human metabolite. It is a conjugate acid of a quinaldate.
used in determination of copper, zinc & uranium with which it forms insol. salts; insulin-releasing effect in islands of Langerhans; structure
